text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Sapporo is the best~~♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arriving in Hokkaido ahead of the Sapporo Kinen,
Fusaichi Pandora was in top condition!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The food's crazy good, it's super spacious, and it's nice and cool!
Insane♡ I'm getting so hyped~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: It feels like having the flu the other day was just a bad dream♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes, several weeks ago,
Fusaichi Pandora had come down with a high fever.”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...*cough cough*. Ah, hellooo?
Hey, go buy me some ice cream right now♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but the convenience store is open!
Please, pretty please! Ice cream is the only thing I can stomach right now~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Ehe♡ Thanks♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...and while she was being pushed around, I was
still worried. At one point, I even thought about
withdrawing from the race, but she managed to recover."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I panicked at first, but hey,
I ended up gathering intel during my break anyway!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I got to learn a whole lot about the Tiara Umamusume of the next generation, too, so all's well that ends well—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did I not tell Trainer?
Well, you already know, right?
Vodka-chan's "Tokyo Yushun"!
choice_data_list: Of course, since it caused quite a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Indeed. Just the other day, Vodka had
successfully conquered the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)!”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
She was blazing down the Tiara route, but then took a sharp turn
to enter the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And then she actually goes and wins! Talk about blowing my mind!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Scarlet won the Oka Sho, but I've been seeing
her a lot around the training grounds lately too~"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's super intense, totally crazy.
That generation is insane, they're really on fire!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Seriously, I can't let myself lose either.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Mwah♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I may be like this, but I've been training
with all my might just as always!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
the much-anticipated day of the Sapporo Kinen arrived.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Then, please give us a brief word
on your enthusiasm for the Sapporo Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win here with a bang
and carry that momentum into back-to-back Queen Elizabeth II Cup titles☆"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Seriously, I'll do super-duper best-est! ♡

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Back-to-back Queen Elizabeth II Cup victories...! I overheard a rather intriguing goal just now—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
First up today, the Sapporo Kinen!
Give it your best!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yup♡
Make sure the photos look super cute!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a cheerful greeting—
the curtain opened on the Sapporo Kinen!
